feedback: The candidate reward machine is well-formed and semantically faithful. Header includes nonempty FINAL_STATES (u4), all states declared, u4 accepting for the task (pickup completes the episode). Ordered transition coverage is correct and matches the constraint chain: key_found -> has_matching_key -> target_door_open -> (target_room_entered & target_picked_up). The u0 transition (u0, key_found & has_matching_key) -> u2 correctly handles the same-step case where the key is picked up as soon as it is seen (pickup happens at the cell in front, which is always in view), and the reward 0.2 matches the sum of the two progress steps. All other propositions are covered by per-state else self-loops, so irrelevant events (turns, moves, wrong-door toggles, drops) cause no state change and no reward. has_matching_key and target_door_open can regress (drop the key, shut the door), but since the RM only transitions on their becoming true and holds via else self-loops, re-earning them later would re-grant the 0.1/0.2 rewards — this is consistent with a dense-but-bounded progress design and does not admit unbounded reward (each transition grants once per regression cycle, and target_room_entered/target_picked_up are strictly progressing; target_picked_up is terminal). Rewards are dense (0.1, 0.2, 0.2) and bounded, with the final reward 1.0 on pickup. Predicate-only events are fine: no action names appear in propositions. The latches (key_found, target_room_entered) need no special handling since u3 requires target_room_entered only jointly with target_picked_up, which is reachable while the latch holds. One minor note: entering the room without picking up yields no reward, but target_room_entered alone is not one of the example tasks' required milestones and the joint transition at u3 keeps the machine compact and safe. Format matches the exact paper syntax.

All five declared propositions are present with correct semantics: key_found and target_room_entered latch via previous_valuation; the view-based key reading, ball-row target room/door identification, doorway-inclusive entry, and mission-matched ball pickup all match the documented API and code notes. No extras, mutations, imports, or syntax errors.
